title: A test requires that a member can leave the gym with a ready order still at the desk
what: The journey says a member must never end up out of the gym with an order still open at the desk. The leave test does the opposite: with one order ready at the desk, the member taps 'Leave anyway', the phone leaves the gym, and the ready order stays open. Also the journey's 'Your order isn't cancelled yet' with 'Try again' and 'Not now' is the no-internet case; when the desk makes an order ready during the leave the member sees 'Order 4 is ready' with only OK.
expected: The journey and the test agree: either a ready order blocks leaving, or the journey says 'Leave anyway' is allowed and what the desk then does with the order.
how_often: every leave with a ready order
fix_line: Decide if Leave anyway is allowed with a ready order, then make the journey and test say the same

title: The poster scanner screen is never opened in a test
what: No test opens the check-in poster scanner. Its title and hint, the amber 'Wrong QR code' warning and its timing, the camera permission card, the 'Camera is off' card with Open Settings, the camera-did-not-start words, coming back from Settings, and the switch to the check-in screen are all unchecked. The only test reads the code to see it uses the live camera and that a foreign QR opens nothing; the phone flows skip the scanner because it needs a real poster.
expected: A test drives the scanner with a wrong QR, a refused and a later allowed camera, and a good QR, and checks each card and that one check-in screen replaces the scanner.
fix_line: Add a scanner screen test with a fake camera for each state

title: No test proves the plan kept for no-signal days belongs to this member and gym
what: The plan card kept on the phone for the gym with no signal is meant to show only for the member who saved it, and to go when the member leaves. No test reads it back as another member or after a gym switch, and no test shows the kept card offline with its pause and renew rows hidden.
expected: A test saves a plan for one member, switches gym or member, and checks the old plan, name and visits never show; and checks the offline card hides pause and renew.
how_often: every gym switch or shared phone
fix_line: Add a test of the kept plan for a second member and after a switch

title: Cancelling from My orders and its empty and offline states are never checked on screen
what: Only the refusal words are tested. Nothing checks 'Cancelling…' on the button, the refusal shown under the card, that a double tap sends one cancel, the 'No orders yet' page with 'Browse the shop', or the kept orders with the could-not-refresh line when offline.
expected: A screen test of My orders covers a refused cancel, a double tap, the empty page and the offline kept list.
fix_line: Add a My orders screen test for cancel refused, double tap, empty and offline

title: The Pause my plan and Renew my plan sheets are never opened in a test
what: The date rules and the result lines are tested as logic, but no test opens either sheet. The calendar's first month, past days that cannot be picked, the hints, 'Send to the desk' turning on, the double tap, the sheet staying open on a refusal or a failed send, the gym's plan list and its no-plans words are unchecked. The refusal and limit words are checked only as 'some constant', never as the words the member reads, and the one-day pause '1 day' wording has no test.
expected: A screen test opens both sheets and checks the hints, the picking rules, the button state and each refusal's exact words.
fix_line: Add a screen test for both sheets and their refusal words
